s.how: Peel and slice 4 oranges into rounds. Shave 1 fennel bulb and half a red onion paper thin. Arrange on a platter with 60g black olives and torn mint, then dress with 3 tbsp olive oil and flaky salt.

Fry 300g pork mince until browned, then add 2 cups shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot and cook until soft, seasoning with soy. Roll tablespoons into 16 spring roll wrappers, seal with water and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Serve with sweet chilli sauce and soy.

m.note: Noah Cross's lunch, served exactly how he likes it
m.how: Score 2 whole snapper (about 800g each) three times on each side. Stuff with lemon slices, parsley and sliced garlic, rub with olive oil and salt. Grill or bake at 220C for 20 minutes until the flesh flakes at the thickest part. Serve whole, heads on.

w.note: Noah Cross and his yacht club
w.how: Whisk 5 egg yolks with 125ml oil, 125ml orange juice, the zest of 2 oranges, 150g sugar and 200g self-raising flour. Whisk 5 egg whites stiff with 50g sugar and fold in. Bake in an ungreased tube tin at 165C for 50 minutes, cool upside down and glaze with 150g icing sugar mixed with orange juice.

d.note: the San Fernando Valley orange groves the whole fight is about
d.how: Cut 2 oranges into small wedges. For each drink, muddle 3 orange wedges, 4 mint leaves and 15ml brown sugar syrup in a shaker. Add 50ml bourbon, 15ml lemon juice and ice and shake hard for 10 seconds. Strain over crushed ice in a rocks glass and garnish with an orange wheel and a mint sprig. For non-drinkers, swap the bourbon for 80ml fresh orange juice topped with soda.
